hints.title: Collection of Broken Keys
hints.text: Store broken characters in a lookup collection to enable instant character availability checks.

hints.title: Evaluating Words Individually
hints.text: Split the given text into distinct words separated by whitespace.

hints.title: Counting Fully Typable Words
hints.text: A word is typable if none of its letters intersect with the set of broken characters.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: W: total character count of text
complexity.notes: Lookup set membership check per word character.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching linear strings for each character is unnecessarily quadratic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra space for up to 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should write clean tokenization and lookup filtering.
